evals.name: upload-feature-specs
evals.prompt: I'm about to build the feature where family members upload doctor visit recordings. Nothing is coded yet. How should it behave when people misuse it?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Writes scenarios in a Given/When/Then style in plain language
Includes a misuse scenario about a wrong, oversized, or malicious file
Includes a scenario where one family tries to reach another family's recording
Cites OWASP or marks each scenario as automatable or review

evals.name: portal-credentials
evals.prompt: New feature: users paste their insurance portal login so the app can check claim status. Nothing is built yet. How do I design this safely?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Produces behavior scenarios or specs rather than only code
Covers credentials never being stored in plain text or written to logs
Covers a different family member trying to use or view someone else's stored login
Treats plain text storage of these logins as a severe or critical risk

evals.name: search-box-specs
evals.prompt: I'm adding a search box that looks up products in the database. Nothing is coded yet. What behaviour should I specify so it is built securely?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Includes a scenario where search text contains database query syntax and is treated as plain data
Writes scenarios in a Given/When/Then style
Includes a scenario about what the user sees and what is logged when the search fails
Marks scenarios as testable by a script versus needing a reviewer, or cites an OWASP source
